text:
kelly-cs: Marigold AI asked if we can open UK region peering and grant a temporary QPS lift for a time-boxed product launch tomorrow morning. They also need our public IPs added to their proxy allowlist. Can infra and eng help?

sam-infra: On it. Need CIDR(s) and exact UTC window. Also confirm: hosted in eu-west-2 (London) okay or do they require Dedicated?

kelly-cs: Hosted is fine. CIDR to whitelist: 203.0.113.0/24. Requested window: 2024-06-10T06:00:00Z -> 2024-06-13T06:00:00Z. Increase from 100 qps to 800 qps. Auto-revoke after window.

javier-eng: Hosted in eu-west-2 can handle 800 qps but we'll add a canary route and adjust autoscale to aggressive for the window. Need to plan KV cache warmup and prefix caching so tail latency stays low.

sam-infra: I'll create infra change for peering + allowlist. ops-bot: created CHG-49207 for UK peering + whitelist + temporary rate bump.

ops-bot: CHG-49207: create eu-west-2 peering, add 203.0.113.0/24 to customer allowlist, set account_rate_limit_override=800 qps from 2024-06-10T06:00:00Z to 2024-06-13T06:00:00Z. Auto-revoke enabled. Assigned: sam-infra, javier-eng.

mina-am: Note that Marigold has a renewal review next week. They reported elevated EU latency last quarter; this launch is important for the renewal discussion. Please attach a post-launch checklist and SLA notes to the change ticket.

kelly-cs: Will capture launch metrics and pass to Mina. Also customer asked about SNI behavior—do we require any special config if their proxy terminates TLS?

javier-eng: For hosted endpoints, SNI is supported automatically. If their proxy forwards TLS, they should preserve the Host header and TLS to our edge. Example:

```
# preserve TLS to our edge
curl -H "Host: api.redwood.ai" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```

javier-eng: If they must terminate TLS at the proxy, have them share the cert thumbprint and we can whitelist it.

sam-infra: Preparing peering schedule. Will announce three public IPs for allowlist in ~15m. Also setting autoscale min_replicas=3 for the window.

kelly-cs: Marigold ops scheduled a whitebox test at 06:15 UTC. Please run warmup traffic 10 minutes before launch: small steady ramp.

javier-eng: Added warmup steps to CHG-49207: 10 concurrent reqs @ 06:00, 50 reqs @ 06:05, then progressive ramp to target. Also added a health check route and short-circuit to canary if errors spike.

ops-bot: CHG-49207 updated: warmup script added, autoscaling policy updated, whitelist staged.

alex-sales: FYI I notified the customer's account lead that we prioritized the region for their launch. They requested a one-pager summarizing launch support for the renewal meeting.

kelly-cs: I'll compile post-launch notes, latency dashboards (p50/p95/p99), and cost impact for Mina.

sam-infra: Quick question: should the temporary lift be implemented as a per-account override or a global exception? I recommend per-account rule so it's scoped and auto-revocable.

kelly-cs: Agreed — per-account rule. Label: marigold-launch-2024, auto_revoke timestamp set.

javier-eng: Implemented: account_rate_limit_override = 800 qps, id=rr-marigold-2024, auto_revoke=2024-06-13T06:00:00Z.

ops-bot: CHG-49207 status: staged -> scheduled. Oncall routing configured for launch window.

kelly-cs: Thanks team :thumbsup: I'll run the enablement call and confirm test times with Marigold.

mina-am: If post-launch metrics look good I'll move renewal risk from red to yellow.

alex-sales: Good luck — ping me if anything needs escalation with the customer. :rocket:
